versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ עַל־דִּגְל֤וֹ בְאֹתֹת֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִנֶּ֕גֶד סָבִ֥יב לְאֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד יַחֲנֽוּ׃

controles.web: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses: at a distance from the Tent of Meeting shall they encamp around it.”
controles.kjv: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Israel acamparão cada um junto à sua bandeira, segundo as insígnias das casas de seus pais; ao redor do tabernáculo do testemunho acamparão.

versos.hebraico: וְהַחֹנִים֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃

controles.web: Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
controles.kjv: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
controles.livre: Estes acamparão ao levante, ao oriente: a bandeira do exército de Judá, por seus esquadrões; e o chefe dos filhos de Judá, Naassom filho de Aminadabe:

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
controles.livre: Seu exército, com os contados deles, setenta e quatro mil e seiscentos.

versos.hebraico: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּעָֽר׃

controles.web: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
controles.kjv: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
controles.livre: Junto a ele acamparão os da tribo de Issacar: e o chefe dos filhos de Issacar, Natanael filho de Zuar;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com seus contados, cinquenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos:

versos.hebraico: מַטֵּ֖ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־חֵלֹֽן׃

controles.web: The tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
controles.kjv: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
controles.livre: E a tribo de Zebulom: e o chefe dos filhos de Zebulom, Eliabe filho de Helom;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com seus contados, cinquenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: כָּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוּדָ֗ה מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְשֵֽׁשֶׁת־אֲלָפִ֥ים וְאַרְבַּע־מֵא֖וֹת לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס

controles.web: All who were numbered of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.
controles.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
controles.livre: Todos os contados no exército de Judá, cento e oitenta e seis mil e quatrocentos, por seus esquadrões, irão diante.

versos.hebraico: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה רְאוּבֵ֛ן תֵּימָ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃

controles.web: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
controles.kjv: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
controles.livre: A bandeira do exército de Rúben ao sul, por seus esquadrões: e o chefe dos filhos de Rúben, Elizur filho de Sedeur;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, seus contados, quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: וְהַחוֹנִ֥ם עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּרִֽי־שַׁדָּֽי׃

controles.web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
controles.kjv: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
controles.livre: E acamparão junto a ele os da tribo de Simeão: e o chefe dos filhos de Simeão, Selumiel filho de Zurisadai;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com os contados deles, cinquenta e nove mil e trezentos:

versos.hebraico: וְמַטֵּ֖ה גָּ֑ד וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־רְעוּאֵֽל׃

controles.web: “The tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
controles.kjv: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
controles.livre: E a tribo de Gade: e o chefe dos filhos de Gade, Eliasafe filho de Reuel;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com os contados deles, quarenta e cinco mil seiscentos e cinquenta.

versos.hebraico: כָּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֗ן מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וְאֶחָ֨ד וַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁנִיִּ֖ם יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס

controles.web: “All who were numbered of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.
controles.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
controles.livre: Todos os contados no exército de Rúben, cento cinquenta e um mil quatrocentos e cinquenta, por seus esquadrões, irão na segunda posição.

versos.hebraico: וְנָסַ֧ע אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֛ד מַחֲנֵ֥ה הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲנוּ֙ כֵּ֣ן יִסָּ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל־יָד֖וֹ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.
controles.kjv: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
controles.livre: Logo irá o tabernáculo do testemunho, o acampamento dos levitas em meio dos exércitos: da maneira que assentam o acampamento, assim caminharão, cada um em seu lugar, junto a suas bandeiras.

versos.hebraico: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם יָ֑מָּה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃

controles.web: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
controles.kjv: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
controles.livre: A bandeira do exército de Efraim por seus esquadrões, ao ocidente: e o chefe dos filhos de Efraim, Elisama filho de Amiúde;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty thousand five hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com os contados deles, quarenta mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: וְעָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָהצֽוּר׃

controles.web: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
controles.kjv: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
controles.livre: Junto a ele estará a tribo de Manassés; e o chefe dos filhos de Manassés, Gamaliel filho de Pedazur;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com os contados deles, trinta e dois mil e duzentos:

versos.hebraico: וּמַטֵּ֖ה בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: “The tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
controles.kjv: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
controles.livre: E a tribo de Benjamim: e o chefe dos filhos de Benjamim, Abidã filho de Gideoni;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His army, and those who were numbered of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com os contados deles, trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: כָּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֗יִם מְאַ֥ת אֶ֛לֶף וּשְׁמֹֽנַת־אֲלָפִ֥ים וּמֵאָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס

controles.web: “All who were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.
controles.kjv: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
controles.livre: Todos os contados no exército de Efraim, cento e oito mil e cem, por seus esquadrões, irão na terceira posição.

versos.hebraico: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה דָ֛ן צָפֹ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃

controles.web: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
controles.kjv: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
controles.livre: A bandeira do exército de Dã estará ao norte, por seus esquadrões: e o chefe dos filhos de Dã, Aiezer filho de Amisadai;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com os contados deles, sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.

versos.hebraico: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עָכְרָֽן׃

controles.web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
controles.kjv: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
controles.livre: Junto a ele acamparão os da tribo de Aser: e o chefe dos filhos de Aser, Pagiel filho de Ocrã;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֧ד וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com os contados deles, quarenta e um mil e quinhentos:

versos.hebraico: וּמַטֵּ֖ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃

controles.web: “The tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
controles.kjv: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
controles.livre: E a tribo de Naftali: e o chefe dos filhos de Naftali, Aira filho de Enã;

versos.hebraico: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: E seu exército, com os contados deles, cinquenta e três mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִים֙ לְמַ֣חֲנֵה דָ֔ן מְאַ֣ת אֶ֗לֶף וְשִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לָאַחֲרֹנָ֥ה יִסְע֖וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: “All who were numbered of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”
controles.kjv: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
controles.livre: Todos os contados no exército de Dã, cento cinquenta e sete mil e seiscentos: irão os últimos atrás de suas bandeiras.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כָּל־פְּקוּדֵ֤י הַֽמַּחֲנֹת֙ לְצִבְאֹתָ֔ם שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

controles.web: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were numbered of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
controles.kjv: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
controles.livre: Estes são os contados dos filhos de Israel, pelas casas de seus pais: todos os contados por exércitos, por seus esquadrões, seiscentos três mil quinhentos e cinquenta.

versos.hebraico: וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֔וּ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Mas os levitas não foram contados entre os filhos de Israel; como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֵּֽן־חָנ֤וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם֙ וְכֵ֣ן נָסָ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖יו עַל־בֵּ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
controles.livre: E fizeram os filhos de Israel conforme todas as coisas que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés; assim assentaram o acampamento por suas bandeiras, e assim marcharam cada um por suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais.
